'''S-Thread Tracker'''<ref name="GG9" /> was a type of long-range [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]].<ref name="MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] often concealed S-Thread Trackers in cargo containers that were known to be heading to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] bases. However, due to the remote location of the bases, the trackers usually only narrowed the location of the base down to the nearest ten [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]].<ref name="GG9" /> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had dummy [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] fitted with S-Thread Trackers aboard ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]''.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
